requirement: Describe CP007A as an optional prospective, multicenter follow-on of CP007, evaluating durability for up to five years after original randomized double-blind treatment, with no new investigational product in CP007A.
acceptable_values: up to five years after treatment

evidence.text: Protocol synopsis and design describe the prospective follow-on and absence of additional treatment.

requirement: Retain the three CP007 randomized regimens: one Cat-PAD course (4 x 6 nmol then placebo), two Cat-PAD courses (8 x 6 nmol), and eight placebo doses, originally dosed every four weeks.

evidence.text: The SAP enumerates the three inherited CP007 regimens.
The protocol describes the parent-study randomized arms.

requirement: Analyze each annual three-week Allergy Evaluation Period scheduled at the same time of year as the CP007 baseline period, with daily symptoms, asthma symptoms, medication use and cat exposure plus annual questionnaires.

evidence.text: The protocol defines timing and assessments.
The SAP confirms the 21-day annual collection.

requirement: State that eligibility is limited to CP007 participants completing PAC3, so no formal new sample-size calculation governs enrollment; contextualize 266 evaluable per arm as yielding at least 99% power for a 25% difference and at least 80% for a 15% difference under Holm-adjusted alpha 0.025.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the eligibility-driven size and precision/power examples.

requirement: Use the annual FAS as primary: consented CP007A subjects with at least one day of annual symptom and rescue-medication data, analyzed by CP007 randomized treatment; re-assess membership each year.
acceptable_values: at least one day symptom and medication data

evidence.text: The SAP defines annual FAS membership and treatment attribution.

notes: The protocol calls its primary set ITT; the SAP operationally labels it FAS.

requirement: Define annual mITT as the FAS subset still living with an indoor cat during that year's evaluation period, analyzed by original randomized arm, and use it as a supportive analysis.

evidence.text: The SAP defines a time-varying annual indoor-cat mITT subset.

requirement: Include all CP007A subjects in safety and attribute safety summaries to treatment actually received in CP007, while efficacy remains as randomized.

evidence.text: The SAP explicitly separates safety and efficacy attribution.

requirement: Define the primary efficacy variable for each annual period as the subject mean of daily Combined Score, CS = TRSS/8 + RMS, averaged over available non-missing days among Days 1-21.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies mean Combined Score.
The SAP gives the daily formula and available-day mean.

requirement: Derive TRSS as the sum of eight 0-3 symptom items and RMS as the day's maximum medication category from 0 to 3; set daily TRSS missing if any symptom item is missing and daily CS missing if TRSS or RMS is missing.
acceptable_values: TRSS missing if any item missing
CS missing if TRSS or RMS missing

evidence.text: The SAP defines symptom, medication and missing-component derivations.

requirement: Use the pre-randomization three-week CP007 Allergy Evaluation Period as efficacy baseline and calculate change as annual value minus baseline.

evidence.text: The SAP fixes baseline source and change direction.

requirement: For each annual primary FAS analysis, fit ANCOVA for mean CS with treatment, pooled site, randomized age group, gender, baseline asthma status and baseline CS; report active-placebo LS-mean differences, two-sided 95% CIs and p-values.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies covariate-adjusted treatment comparisons.
The SAP identifies ANCOVA factors and outputs.

requirement: Apply Holm to the two active-versus-placebo comparisons: test the smaller p-value at 0.025, then the other at 0.05 if the first passes; declare that year's study result successful if at least one active regimen differs significantly from placebo.
acceptable_values: at least one active arm succeeds

evidence.text: The protocol gives Holm testing for the two comparisons.
The SAP states the exact order and success criterion.

requirement: Plan four annual unblinded analyses; perform each later-year analysis only after a positive preceding year, treating the years as hierarchical without additional across-year alpha adjustment, and preserve blinded programming with independent unblinding.
acceptable_values: later year only if prior year positive

evidence.text: The SAP specifies annual analysis gates and unblinding separation.

requirement: Use available-day mean CS for the primary analysis and repeat ANCOVA after filling all 21 days separately by LOCF, subject-period worst observation carried forward, and baseline mean carried forward.

evidence.text: The SAP gives the primary available-case calculation and three imputation sensitivities.

requirement: Also fit a daily-CS MAR MMRM in FAS and mITT with the ANCOVA factors, Kenward-Roger degrees of freedom, and a covariance structure selected by minimum AIC from the prespecified candidate structures, considering treatment-specific covariance.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies the MAR MMRM, covariance search and SAS DDFM=KR.

requirement: Analyze secondary TRSS, nasal/ocular components, RMS and RQLQ using analogous adjusted active-placebo comparisons, and summarize asthma symptoms, onset and progression with logistic regression for annual asthma diagnosis where applicable.

evidence.text: The SAP defines secondary outcome analyses.

notes: Secondary active-placebo tests are nominal 0.05 and do not use primary Holm adjustment.

requirement: Summarize cumulative AEs descriptively in safety by SOC/PT, maximum severity and strongest relationship, plus withdrawals, SAEs and deaths; do not conduct treatment comparisons unless explicitly specified.

evidence.text: The SAP defines safety population outputs and conservative missing severity/relationship handling.

requirement: Ask the statistical team to confirm the protocol-ITT versus SAP-FAS naming, annual analysis-set authorization, exact handling after intercurrent changes in cat exposure, yearly stopping implications, and whether later-year nominal inference remains valid after selection.

evidence.text: The protocol labels the primary set ITT and gives broad yearly logic.
The SAP operationalizes dynamic annual FAS/mITT sets and selection-based year gates.
